title: How to Snake a Clogged Drain with a Drum Auger (Snake) - This Old House
summary: The video demonstrates clearing a bathtub/shower drain using a drum auger (drain snake) rather than harsh chemical cleaners. It explains why chemical cleaners can be damaging, identifies common clog culprits (notably hair), and walks through the steps of removing the strainer, feeding the auger, locking and twisting to advance the cable, and checking the drain for clearance. The host also covers tub installations with overflows and explains why the snake must be routed through the overflow and the trap to avoid getting stuck, underscoring a practical, money-saving homeowners’ method for addressing drains safely.

sections.description: The video opens by depicting a common bathroom backup and warns against corrosive drain cleaners, recommending a drum auger (snake) as a safe, effective alternative. It introduces the drain’s trap as a potential blockage site and notes that the clog can be in the trap or the horizontal pipe below the floor.
